artist.name: Norbu
artist.bio: Norbu is an electronic music producer, sound designer and DJ from Chandigarh, active in the underground scene since 2021. His music sits between leftfield bass, dubstep, UK garage, DnB and IDM, with releases on Deep Tempo Records, OneFortyAsia, Sec13 Records and Screech Collective.

eras.sound: Leftfield bass, dubstep, garage, DnB and IDM
